faqs.question: Are Velcro patches and hook-and-loop patches the same thing?
faqs.answer: Hook-and-loop is the generic name for the two-part fastening system. VELCRO is a brand name often used informally for it. Tell us if your specification requires genuine VELCRO brand material so we can confirm availability in the quote.

faqs.question: Should I choose an embroidered or PVC face with hook-and-loop backing?
faqs.answer: Choose embroidery for a classic stitched texture and uniform-style badge. A molded PVC face with hook-and-loop backing suits raised designs and outdoor gear. The face and backing are separate choices; send your artwork and use conditions for a recommendation.

faqs.question: What is the minimum order for custom Velcro patches?
faqs.answer: The standard bulk MOQ is 200 pcs per design and construction. Different designs and constructions are quoted separately. Sample development is available before bulk production.

faqs.question: Do you include the matching loop piece?
faqs.answer: Specify hook backing only if your garment or gear already has a compatible loop panel. If it does not, request a matching sew-on loop piece with each patch and confirm this in the quote.

faqs.question: Can I attach a hook-backed patch directly to any fabric?
faqs.answer: No. Hook backing needs a compatible loop surface for reliable attachment. For garments without a loop panel, add a suitable loop panel or choose a direct sew-on construction.

faqs.question: Can woven patches also have hook-and-loop backing?
faqs.answer: Yes. A woven face can be paired with hook-and-loop backing when the design needs fine lettering or detailed textile artwork. We review the size, edge finish and backing before production.

faqs.question: Can the patches be removed before washing?
faqs.answer: Yes, removability is a key reason to choose hook-and-loop backing. Follow the care instructions confirmed for the selected materials, and keep the fastening surfaces clear of lint and debris. Confirm any industrial-laundry requirements before ordering.

faqs.question: What do I need to send for a quote?
faqs.answer: Send your artwork or idea, patch dimensions, face material, quantity per design, required backing, delivery destination and deadline. Tell us whether you also need matching loop pieces. We review the construction before quoting.
